title: Midring patrol: when the farm gate is open and B12/B13 have nothing to walk to, walk a short zone-safe midring path instead of holding
stage: built (smoke/hazard only; needs Sim Tester full screen)
single_decision: Where the champion would stand in mode 'hold' with farmOk true, not hurt (noSneak), and no B12/B13 cube, drop, drone or crate to walk to, walk a short zone-safe nav leg to the next waypoint of a zig-zag patrol at zone ratio ~0.45-0.65 of the circle we keep to (the next circle once inside its inner ring, else the current one with the farm zone-safety test). No boost. Every existing branch (zone escape, leave for the next circle, engage, retreat, collect, laser walk, crossfire, ambush, drop hold/run, heal, loot, farm capture/pickup/hunt, standoff break) stays above it, so any of them breaks the patrol at once. Own no-progress guard: a leg that is not found, too long, or not closing for 2 s is dropped and the direction flips; 3 failed legs in a row, or 6 s of patrol with under 4 m of movement, rest the patrol (hold) for 10 s. Off when the circle is under 70 m. MIDRING_PATROL_ON=false (default) = champion byte-identical.
evidence: coord/data/watcher/SKILLS.md (93 showdown matches, T01-T04 vs T13-T16): hold 24.6% vs 40.1% of ticks (d=-0.34), mid-phase hold 28.5% vs 48.2% (d=-0.42; 6231/5574 ticks, 54/56 matches); speed while healthy and not engaged 7.21 vs 4.35 m/s (d=0.55); idle cube rate 3.94 vs 2.27 /min, mid-phase 5.11 vs 3.12; most high-team cubes are gained in the midring (909) not the center (638); best place/cubes in the 20-40% center-share bin. Champion gap 2 in SKILLS.md: the champion holds when nothing is in the 80 m cube / 150 m hunt window. Correlation in exhibition FFA, not house-bot proof. ideas_queue.md item 3 (Medium) and item 5.
